{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Heavy wool coat, straight cut, mid-thigh length, charcoal gray, #36454F.
Dark wash denim jeans, slim fit, ankle length, black, heavy cotton twill.
White turtleneck knit top, relaxed neckline, hip length, off-white, fine merino wool.
Chunky leather combat boots, lace-up, mid-calf height, black, waterproof oiled leather.

This outfit prioritizes warmth and durability against the frosty, snowy conditions while adhering to her reading-focused occasion which allows for movement like a short walk. The dark denim and white knit provide a neat casual aesthetic that fits the "everyday" formality band without being too dressy. Heavy wool and waterproof leather are chosen specifically because of the salted roads and sub-zero temperatures, ensuring she stays comfortable and protected."}
